newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMANY BEAT UKRAINE 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANY BEAT UKRAINE 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Germany beat Ukraine 2-0 (halftime 0-0) in their World Cup group nine qualifier on Wednesday.

Germany - 1-Andreas Koepke, 2-Joerg Heinrich, 3-Christian Ziege, 4-Juergen Kohler, 5-Thomas Helmer, 6-Dieter Eilts, 7-Oliver Bierhof, 8-Mario Basler, 9-Juergen Klinsmann, 10-Dariusz Wosz (18-Michael Tarnat 83), 11-Fredi Bobic (15-Jens Nowotny 16).

Ukraine - 1-Olexander Kosovsky, 2-Oleg Luzhnyi, 3-Sergiy Bejenar, 4-Alexander Golovko, 5-Viktor Skrypnzk (13-Orbu 70), 6-Sergiy Nagornyak (17-Vladislav Vashchyuk 70), 7-Yuri Maksimov, 8-Yuri Kalitvintsev (18-Dmitro Mikhailenko 77), 9-Vitaly Kosovsky, 10-Andriy Shevchenko, 11-Sergiy Rebrov.
